text:
Lena Gomez: Quick check — OrionCloud sent final playbook + 1-pager for EU launch. Need logo lockups, quote approval, and accessibility alt text. TL;DR: partner wants publish next Tue. Can we review today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Rob Park: I can review visuals. Which logo variants did they include?
Lena Gomez: They attached: orion_logo_full.svg, orion_logo_mark.svg, orion_logo_white.svg (links) — see attachments in thread. Also included a customer quote from AstraFin: "Redwood made scale effortless." Need legal ok on the wording.
Nina Shah: downloading assets now. Quick note: white logo on dark blue hero has too little clearspace; we should increase padding to 32px. Also their SVG has embedded raster in one artboard.
Ben Kline: Quote looks fine but want partner to confirm attribution format. Legal needs explicit opt-in from AstraFin. Also, remove the phrase "seamless, zero-downtime" — that's a claim we don't have signed data for.
Lena Gomez: Ben noted. Cora, can you ping Orion to update the quote and sign off on attribution?
Cora Li: On it. Draft message: "Can you confirm AstraFin's approval to use the quote, and please remove 'zero-downtime' reference or provide supporting metric? Thanks!" Sending now.
asset-bot: automated asset check results — orion_playbook_v2.pdf: missing alt text for 3 images; orion_logo_white.svg: viewBox missing; orion_logo_full.svg: OK; color contrast on hero CTA fails AA small text.
Nina Shah: I'll upload a corrected hero JPG and a fixed SVG with proper viewBox. Also proposing CTA text change to "Get started" -> better contrast.
Rob Park: Can we avoid changing the CTA too late? It's in the marketplace listing too.
Lena Gomez: We'll coordinate. Plan: Nina uploads fixed assets by EOD, Ben confirms legal wording, Cora gets partner sign-off. If all green, marketing publishes Monday morning EU time. Everyone ok?
Ben Kline: OK pending partner confirmation. I will provisionally approve the quote if partner confirms AstraFin opt-in.
Nina Shah: Uploaded: /assets/orion/logo_full_fixed.svg, /assets/orion/hero_v2.jpg, alt text suggestions included in the doc.
Cora Li: Orion replied: "Confirmed — AstraFin approved and removed the phrase. Attached signed approval." PDF link provided.
Rob Park: Awesome. Final ask: can design export marketplace thumbnail 1200x628 and a square 800x800 for social? Nina?
Nina Shah: Yes — done. Links: thumb_1200x628.jpg, social_800x800.jpg
Lena Gomez: Great job team. I'll schedule publish and send final co-marketing checklist to Orion. :tada:
Rob Park: :party_parrot:
